text: OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote for abacavir. It is not known whether abacavir can be removed by peritoneal dialysis or hemodialysis. One case of an adult ingesting 6 grams of lamivudine was reported; there were no clinical signs or symptoms noted and hematologic tests remained normal. It is not known whether lamivudine can be removed by peritoneal dialysis or hemodialysis.
